comment: Every item must be covered by a passing result, or carry a waiver, in at least one report attached to the release candidate. Section numbers refer to docs/SHIMMER3_TEST_PROCEDURE.md. Gates 1 and 2 are not listed: CI proves them on the tagged commit.

items.title: Factory self-test read and checked against the board revision
Boot, identity and radio banner recorded
Per-model behaviour walked on the models the change touches
Rest of gate 4 walked on at least one unit
Shipping host stack against the release candidate
A recording from the previous release still imports
Version skew walked in both directions
Any compatibility change made loud: version bumped, document and host reference updated, host version named in the release notes
Regression cases considered against what changed
